name: Shisen'in Mizuho
source:
Third daughter of the Shisen'in house. (Kanori and Mutsuki's younger sister.)
Don't let her childish and cute appearance fool you! She is the most selfish and naughty from all of the Shisen'in sisters. She knows all of the best techniques for teasing men.
